Feature:Contacts — a contact person with their own postal address 17s 113ms 5

A contact person filed under a customer may keep their own postal address
instead of the customer's. This is deliberately end-to-end rather than a
duplicate of the ORM-level unit tests covering the same rules: Odoo hides
the address block on a Kontakt and only the "Eigene Adresse verwenden"

has to hold through a real form save — the address synchronisation runs on

@hr @task-319 @regression
Feature:HR — booking an Anpassung in the Abwesenheitshistorie 4s 68ms 1

A correction that is not an absence (a transfer from another Niederlassung,
say) has no native Odoo record: an allocation cannot be negative and a leave
would show up as an absence. HR books it as an Anpassung directly in the
Abwesenheitshistorie, with a mandatory reason, and the running Gesamt takes
it into account immediately. This is deliberately end-to-end: the editable
grid, the validation dialog and the recomputed Gesamt are OWL list behaviour
no unit test can observe.

beide Daten ein" on every Antrag senden. The type select's placeholder was
not the selected option, so the browser displayed the first real type while
the form's state held "nothing chosen". Playwright drives the real form here

chosen type with two dates must reach Odoo as a request.

Feature:A forgotten check-out is visible in the Employee App 14s 726ms 3

Task #358: an employee who checked in yesterday and never checked out is
greeted the next morning by "Eingecheckt seit 06:05" with no date and no
warning, and when a new check-in silently closes yesterday's visit the app
says nothing. The server side of both situations (the auto-close at the
planned end, the nightly job, the validation queue) is covered by the Odoo
unit tests of wolfinne_ifms_employee_pwa (TestEmployeePwaForgottenCheckout).
Playwright drives the real app here because what is under test is what the
OWL card and the notice *render* from that payload: the day on the mark,

must still be there, and the sentence after a check-in that closed a visit.

@hr @task-412 @regression
Feature:A user keeps their own Unterschrift under Meine Präferenzen 5s 91ms 1

Unterschrift 1 on a new Angebot is prefilled with the user's own employee,
but only when that employee carries a signature image, and until task #412
only Personalwesen could store one. Now every internal user uploads their
own image under Meine Präferenzen (the page they already use for their
password and private address), so the Angebot saves without a detour
through HR.

The rule itself is proven at unit level (test_own_signature_my_preferences:
own record writable without HR rights, a colleague's not, the quote default
following). What only the browser shows is the path the user walks: the
field on the dialog behind their name, the upload through the image widget,
and Unterschrift 1 filled on the next Angebot.

@planning @task-357 @regression
Feature:Planning Mitarbeiter picker — stepping outside the own hierarchy 8s 966ms 1

A planner may assign any active employee of the company to a shift, but the
Mitarbeiter dialog still opens on their own team so the everyday list stays
short; reaching the rest of the company is a deliberate act.

End-to-end because the behaviour under test is a rendered search state, not a
computed set. Which employees the planner may assign is already proven at the
unit level by test_planning_company_wide_assignment; what no TransactionCase
can observe is that the dialog opens with the Mein Team facet applied, that
removing it is what widens the visible list, and that a name from the widened
list is selectable and lands on the form. That is AC-1 and AC-2.

It deliberately stops at the form. Saving is covered by
test_planning_company_wide_assignment, including the part a browser test
would have to stage an Objekt for: a shift for somebody outside your team on
a project that is not yours is refused by rule_planning_slot_global_scope,
so "it saves" is two rules interacting rather than one rendering.

in the running web client: the German label text the planner reads, and
that an invisible="1" field is really absent from the dialog's DOM rather
than present and hidden. This one scenario is that rendering smoke check.

@project @regression @task-286
Feature:Project form — Kunde is reachable, Objekt is required only with one 2s 925ms 1

A project without a customer must stay editable and savable, while a project
that names one still cannot be saved without its Objekt. This is deliberately
end-to-end because the defect lived entirely in the client's modifier
evaluation: the Objekt was required unconditionally while Odoo hid the Kunde
field on a project that is neither billable nor field-service, so the form
demanded a value with no reachable source. The ORM never blocked it — the
constraint has always exempted customer-less projects — so no TransactionCase
can reproduce the failure. The unit tests in test_project_property.py assert
the modifiers that reach the client; only a browser proves the record saves.

@project @timesheet-validation @task-324
Feature:Project task — how many reported times still await release 6s 66ms 1

A Bereichsleiterin opens a task and sees, as a stat button, how many
timesheet entries on it still need her release; clicking it opens exactly
those entries, where she validates them. This is deliberately end-to-end for
two reasons the unit level cannot reach. First, the button has to survive
view combination: project.view_task_form2 is inherited by hr_timesheet,
project_enterprise, timesheet_grid and this module, and an arch assertion
proves only that the xpath applied, not that the button rendered in the
assembled form. Second, this is an access rule as the user experiences it —
before #324 a Bereichsleiterin could not see her team's entries at all, so
the number she gets after a real login is the behaviour under test.
The counting rules themselves (validated, absence and public-holiday
exclusion, the project rollup, the action domains) are unit tests in
wolfinne_ifms_customization/tests/test_timesheet_validation_indicator.py, and
the record rule in wolfinne_ifms_access/tests/test_timesheet_scope.py — none
of that is re-proven here. The absence/public-holiday exclusion in particular
cannot be set up from a browser at all: project_timesheet_holidays refuses to
let a non-superuser create or modify a leave-linked timesheet line
(_check_can_create / _check_can_write), so that case belongs to the unit
level by construction.

Feature:The offer tabs stay usable while the placeholder list loads 6s 357ms 1

Task #431: on a new Auftrag, leaving Angebotsfuss (or Angebotskopf) while
its placeholder list (Verfügbare Platzhalter, task #122) was still loading
left the notebook with an active tab and a blank page, and both offer tabs
blank until the page was reloaded (reported on staging on 15.09.2026,
around a Save refused for a missing Unterschrift). The picker shared one
request for the list, fetched through its own component's protected ORM
service: a picker gone before the answer arrived left a request that never
resolves, and the picker held up its page's rendering until the list came.
Deliberately end-to-end: the fault only exists in the browser, between the
notebook's page switch, Owl's rendering and the timing of one request,
which no Python test reaches. The scenario holds the list back so the user
can leave the tab before it arrives, every run.

@regression @sale-order @task-338
Feature:The project of a confirmed Auftrag 7s 911ms 1

Task #338: a Bereichsleiter confirmed a quotation built from the IFMS service
catalogue and got no project, and the manual "Projekt erstellen" button failed
with an access error, because the role only reads projects. Now the seeded
services create the project on confirmation, the button works as a process
step for that role, and the project is managed by the order's
Vertriebsmitarbeiter, so the Bereichsleiter finds it in their own project list.
Fails before the fix: the project has no manager and the Bereichsleiter cannot
see it (with a product tracking "no", it does not exist at all).
Requires: fixture property "Testobjekt Wien" linked to IFMS GmbH, the seeded
product "Hausreinigung" of wolfinne_ifms_data_prod, and signature images on the
Bereichsleiterin's employee and on the Geschaeftsfuehrung signer, because a
Bereichsleiter cannot choose the signers and the form fills them from the
defaults. The Vertriebsmitarbeiter is set explicitly: the project is led by
the Vertriebsmitarbeiter, and the form pre-fills that field from the
customer's salesperson, which an earlier scenario's Niederlassungsleiter
leaves on "IFMS GmbH"; the project would then be his and invisible to her.
